_help: The story, one beat at a time. Beats unlock in order: a beat needs everything in its 'unlock' AND every beat above it. Unlock keys: runs, wins, tokensEarned, glitches (all lifetime totals from the save), and upgrade: { id, level } to sell a log in the shop. 'log' is what the terminal shows (up to 9 lines of 31 characters). 'hub' adds something to the hub when the beat unlocks: scratches (marks on the wall, read with Up; text in 'wall'), stranger (another player; what they say is in 'says'), watching (the machine's lights turn on you). A later beat's 'says' replaces an earlier one. Glitch spins: 'first' is when the first one is forced (it is the next real spin after these are met); after that each spin has 'chance' of glitching. A glitch spin puts 'theme' on the theme reel.
